1. Introduction.
we show that CVaR is a very useful tool for risk-aware design and optimization of Markov chains.
we show how to compute the CVaR for reachability and mean payoff objectives in Markov chains and MDPs, and that the decision problems can be solved in polynomial time.
The main takeaway from our work is that
CVaR constraints are not only compatible with the expectation and VaR constraints, but they can also be replaced by them.
CVaR constraints are not only a useful tool for risk-averse decision making, but also a natural extension of expectation constraints.
CVaR constraints are a good tool to handle risk in Markov Decision processes, in particular when the state space of the system is large and the risk is concerned with a finite set of states.
